verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of an API or agent interface for drafting campaigns against a segment, and none for scheduling, queuing, or a human-approval step before send. Team-member access controls and no-code app integrations are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft a campaign against a segment and leave it scheduled or queued for a human to approve before send
